given: Stay in_house at a reachable Property and the Folio balance is zero
then: Stay becomes departed with ends_on = the Property business date, Reservation becomes checked_out, the Folio is closed, stay.checked_out is published and an audit record is written, all in one transaction

given: Stay in_house with ends_on earlier than the business date
then: check-out succeeds and ends_on becomes the business date rather than the planned one

given: Stay in_house with ends_on later than the business date
when: the Staff Member confirms check-out and acknowledges the early departure
then: check-out succeeds, ends_on becomes the business date, and the acknowledgement is recorded with who and when

given: Stay in_house with ends_on later than the business date
when: the Staff Member confirms check-out without acknowledging
then: check-out is refused

given: Stay in_house with ends_on null
then: ends_on becomes the business date and the Unit is freed

given: Stay in_house with reservation_id null
then: only the Stay changes and no Reservation transition is attempted

given: Stay is departed or cancelled
then: refused because the Stay is no longer in_house

given: Stay belongs to another Organization
then: no row is visible and the refusal does not reveal that the Stay exists

given: Stay is at a Property the Staff Member is not assigned to
then: refused with the same response as a Stay that does not exist

given: Staff Member can reach the Property but does not hold check_out
then: refused

given: Folio has a non-zero balance and no open-Folio choice was made
then: refused

given: a Folio line was posted after the review was rendered
when: the Staff Member confirms check-out with the stale Folio version
then: refused with the bill changed, review again; the version is compared under the per-Stay advisory lock, so a line committed before confirm is always seen

given: two Staff Members hold the same Stay open
then: exactly one succeeds and the other is refused on state rather than on version

given: check-out holds the per-Stay advisory lock
when: a charge is posted to the same Folio
then: check-out completes and the charge is then refused, because the Folio is closed

situation: Charge and correction net to zero
given: a charge and its reversal are posted after the review
then: refused because the Folio version changed even though the balance did not

given: PRE-02 is applied, the Property cutoff is 04:00, and the local time is 01:30 on Tuesday
then: ends_on is Monday because that is the Property business date

given: PRE-02 is applied and the Property cutoff is 04:00
when: check-out is confirmed at 03:59:59 and again at 04:00:00
then: the two land on different business dates and the boundary is inclusive on one side only

given: PRE-02 is applied and the Property is in a time zone that changes its clocks
when: a business date is read on the day the clocks change, or somebody sets a cutoff inside the hours they change in
then: no business date is skipped or repeated: the cutoff is constrained to between 03:00 and 12:00, where no time zone changes its clocks, so it is crossed exactly once a day; a cutoff before 03:00 is refused because a repeated hour would cross it twice

given: a Property changes its business date cutoff while Stays are in house
then: nothing already written is re-dated, in the same way a currency change does not restate a Folio

given: check-in at 01:00 and check-out at 03:00 with a 04:00 cutoff
then: valid only because status becomes departed in the same UPDATE that sets ends_on = starts_on; stays_in_house_has_a_night forbids that pair while the Stay is in_house

given: a Stay has just been checked out
when: another Stay is started in the same Unit the same day
then: it is allowed because the exclusion constraint is partial on status

given: check-out succeeds
then: stay.checked_out is in the outbox in the same transaction

given: check-out succeeds
then: an audit record naming the actor is written in the same transaction

given: the Property does not bill, or the Stay was checked in before Folios existed
when: the Staff Member reviews and confirms check-out
then: the review screen says there is no Folio, no balance or version check is made, and check-out succeeds

given: the migration adding reservations.checked_out is applied to a database holding departed Stays
then: every Reservation whose Stay is departed moves checked_in to checked_out, so no existing row is left breaking the pair rule

given: a Guest prepaid three nights and leaves after one, so the Folio carries a credit
when: the Staff Member confirms check-out in slice 1
then: refused, because slice 1 requires a zero balance: a prepaid early departure needs the slice 2 open-Folio choice

given: a Stay is in_house while its Reservation is not checked_in
then: refused, and the inconsistency is reported rather than repaired in passing; possible only for rows written before CO-S1-29

given: a Stay has a Reservation
when: a transaction would commit a Stay departed with its Reservation not checked_out, or in_house with its Reservation not checked_in
then: refused at commit, on every write, not only at check-out; CO-S1-26 stays as the one-time backfill for rows written before this

given: nothing posts a room charge because no rate exists
then: deferred to the room-charge posting feature, which decides whether nights post at check-in or per night at rollover

situation: Money owed on an early departure
given: a Guest leaves early
when: the charge or refund is computed
then: deferred to the rates and cancellation policy feature

given: a check-out succeeds
when: a bill is printed or emailed
then: deferred to Finance invoicing, which decides whether check-out triggers e-Arsiv or e-Fatura

given: a Guest departs in Turkey
then: deferred to compliance, and required before launch

given: a Property has a cutoff
then: deferred to ADR 0021, which decides automatic cutoff or a manual night audit and who may change a cutoff

given: a Stay in_house with its Reservation checked_in
when: one transaction updates the Stay to departed first and the Reservation to checked_out second
then: succeeds, because the pair check is deferred to commit

given: the Folio balance is a credit and no open-Folio choice was made
then: refused

given: the Folio balance is a credit and the Staff Member holds folio.leave_open_credit
when: they confirm check-out and record a reason
then: check-out succeeds, the Folio stays open with its credit, and the reason and decider are recorded

given: the Folio balance is a debit below the Property limit and the Staff Member holds folio.leave_open_debit
when: they confirm check-out and record a reason
then: check-out succeeds and the Folio is flagged for manager review

given: the Folio balance is a debit above the Property limit
when: the Staff Member confirms check-out with the open-Folio choice
then: refused

given: the Staff Member does not hold folio.leave_open_debit
when: they confirm check-out with a debit balance
then: refused

given: the Folio has a debit balance
when: the Staff Member tries to clear it at check-out
then: not possible: a write-off is a Finance action with its own permission and is not reachable from check-out

given: a Folio was left open at check-out
when: a Manager opens the flagged open Folios list
then: the Folio appears there

given: a Manager reviews a flagged open Folio and rejects the decision
then: undecided: see the open question in use-case.mmd

given: an open-ended Stay is checked out and its Folio is left open for inspection
then: check-out succeeds, the Unit is freed, and the Folio stays open with that reason

given: the Staff Member chooses to leave the Folio open and supplies an empty reason
then: refused

situation: Open-Folio choice on a zero balance
given: the Folio balance is zero and the Staff Member chooses to leave it open anyway
then: refused: the choice contradicts the balance

situation: A charge refused by a closed Folio
given: a drink was served and the Folio has closed
then: deferred to the Folio and F&B late-charge feature

given: a Folio carries a credit
then: deferred to Finance, which decides who approves and above what amount

given: a Stay was checked out on this business date and the Unit has not been taken
when: a Staff Member with check_out.reverse reverses it with a reason
then: Stay returns to in_house, Reservation returns to checked_in, ends_on is restored, a status-change row is appended and stay.check_out_reversed is published

given: another Stay has been started in the Unit since the check-out
then: refused by the exclusion constraint

given: the business date has rolled since the check-out
then: refused

given: the Stay is in_house or cancelled
then: refused

given: the Staff Member does not hold check_out.reverse
then: refused

given: the reversal is attempted without a reason
then: refused

given: an open-ended Stay was checked out and its previous ends_on was null
then: ends_on is restored from the status-change history row, which held null

given: two Staff Members reverse the same check-out simultaneously
then: exactly one succeeds

given: a reversal and a charge on the same Folio run together
then: they serialise on the same per-Stay advisory lock: reversal first reopens the Folio and the charge posts, charge first is refused because the Folio is closed and the reversal then succeeds

given: any Stay is being reversed
then: ends_on is restored from that Stay's own previous value in the status-change history row, never from the Reservation planned dates; that value already satisfied stays_in_house_has_a_night while in_house, so returning to in_house cannot violate it

given: the reversed Stay has no Reservation
then: ends_on is restored from the same history row as any other Stay, by the same rule

given: payments were recorded at check-out
then: the Folio is reopened and no line is removed

given: a status-change row exists
when: an update or delete is attempted against it
then: refused

given: the reversal succeeds
then: stay.check_out_reversed is published in the same transaction

given: a Stay is in_house and nothing is posted to its Folio
when: reverseCheckIn is called with a reason
then: the Stay becomes cancelled and the Unit is freed; covered by the existing check-in reversal tests, which this design does not change

given: a Reservation is checked_in
when: reverseCheckIn is called with a reason
then: the Reservation returns to confirmed; covered by the existing check-in reversal tests

situation: A reversed Reservation is arrivable again
given: a check-in was reversed so the Reservation is confirmed and its Stay is cancelled
when: the Reservation is checked in again
then: a second Stay is created and the cancelled one remains. Fixed in #34 (PR #35) and applied to the hosted database, so this row now describes what the database does rather than what it must be made to do; the test exists and passes.

given: a Stay is cancelled
then: refused: cancelled is terminal

given: a check-in reversal or a check-out reversal succeeds
then: a status-change row is appended for either; the two shapes stay different on purpose, in_house to cancelled saying the check-in never happened and departed to in_house saying the Stay never ended, and ADR 0022 is amended only to add the history row

given: the Organization Subscription is suspended and a Guest is in house
then: check-out succeeds because it is an exit path

given: the Subscription is suspended
then: refused

given: the Subscription is suspended
then: refused

given: the Subscription is past_due
when: any front desk action is attempted
then: everything works and a warning is shown

given: the Subscription has reached its final state
then: refused while export still works

given: the Subscription is suspended and the Staff Member does not hold check_out
then: refused: the exit path relaxes the commercial gate, never the permission or the reach

given: a Subscription lapses
then: deferred to the subscription ADR, which decides the grace period length and who may extend it

given: stays_status_check allows reserved and openStayWithin inserts in_house literally
when: a Stay is created by any route
then: no Stay can be in reserved

situation: A Stay cannot be created without a check-in
given: no command creates a Stay directly
then: a Stay without a Reservation can exist and check-out handles it (CO-S1-06); creating one belongs to another feature

given: reservations exist only as seeded rows
then: not built

given: requested to confirmed has no command
then: not built

given: requested or confirmed to cancelled has no command
then: not built

situation: A Reservation cannot be marked no_show
given: confirmed to no_show has no command
then: not built

situation: reserved to in_house has no command
given: stays_status_check allows reserved and nothing writes it
when: a Stay is moved from reserved to in_house
then: not built: assigning a room to a reserved Stay belongs to the room assignment feature

given: a Reservation is cancelled
then: refused: cancelled is terminal

given: a Reservation is no_show
then: refused: no_show is terminal

given: stays_status_check allows reserved and openStayWithin inserts in_house
then: deferred to the room assignment feature, which decides whether a command is missing or the value is

situation: The built check-out uses a calendar date
given: checkOut computes now at the Property timezone cast to date
when: a check-out is confirmed during a night shift
then: nothing differs any more. checkOut and listDepartures read app.property_today, which applies the cutoff (20260916003500).

situation: The built check-out leaves the Reservation behind
given: checkOut updates only the Stay
when: a Stay with a Reservation is checked out
then: the Stay becomes departed while the Reservation stays checked_in, so rows already in the database break the pair rule; adding reservations.checked_out needs a migration that backfills checked_in to checked_out for every Reservation whose Stay is departed

situation: The built check-out never reads the Folio
given: checkOut calls closeStayWithin and publishes
when: a Stay with an unpaid balance is checked out
then: it succeeds and the balance is ignored entirely

given: checkOut takes only a userId and a stayId
when: the desk checks a Guest out
then: there is no Folio version, so the staleness rule of Q6 has nothing to compare against

given: checkOut accepts any in_house Stay
when: a Guest leaves four nights early
then: it succeeds silently and ends_on is overwritten

given: the module exports checkIn reverseCheckIn checkOut listArrivals listDepartures
when: a check-out is made in error
then: nothing can undo it

given: stays_update_front_desk carries gates 1 2 3 and 5
when: a housekeeper who can reach the Property calls checkOut
then: it succeeds; see issue #33

situation: A balance can never be zero
given: folio_lines_kind_check allows only charge and reversal
when: a Guest pays at the desk
then: there is no payment line type, so prerequisite 1 is confirmed and every check-out today would have to use the deliberate open-Folio branch

situation: Folio closure exists but not in the shape check-out needs
given: closeFolio opens its own withOrganizationContext transaction, matches only status = open, and takes no lock
when: check-out tries to close a Folio as part of its own transaction
then: it cannot: a second transaction cannot see check-out's uncommitted work, the balance is never checked, and the per-Stay advisory lock is never taken, so prerequisite 4 becomes closeFolioWithin(tx) with a zero-balance check under the per-Stay lock rather than being struck

situation: Subscription states do not match the design
given: subscriptions_status_check allows trialing active past_due suspended cancelled
then: there is no closed state; the design names active past_due suspended closed, so the ADR must reconcile cancelled and closed

situation: An open-ended Stay holds its Unit forever
given: ends_on is nullable and daterange with a null upper bound is unbounded
when: a Resident Stay has no end date
then: it overlaps every future range, so the Unit cannot be let until the Stay leaves in_house

given: the unique index on stays reservation_id property_id organization_id is partial on status
when: a reversed check-in is checked in again
then: nothing differs any more. It did: the index was total, so a Reservation returned to confirmed by reverseCheckIn could never be checked in again, contradicting ADR 0022's own stated mechanism. Fixed in #34 (PR #35), which also closed the Folio a withdrawn check-in left open.

situation: Record a payment on a Folio
given: folio_lines_kind_check allows only charge and reversal
when: a Guest pays at the desk
then: blocks: s1 (Folio with charges only). Without a payment line such a Folio can never reach zero. A Stay with no Folio (CO-S1-25) or a Folio with no lines is reachable without it.

given: app.property_today returns a calendar date and properties has no cutoff column
when: a check-out or a reversal asks what day it is
then: blocks: none. Applied in 20260916003500_a_business_date_has_a_cutoff: properties.business_date_cutoff (default 04:00, between 03:00 and 12:00) and app.business_date, which app.property_today now applies to now().

given: closeFolio opens its own transaction, checks no balance and takes no lock
when: check-out closes a Folio as part of its own transaction
then: blocks: s1, s3. s1 must close on a zero balance inside the check-out transaction; s3 must reopen inside the reversal.

given: no per-staff permission exists and reaching a Property is the whole of the authorization
when: any permission in this design is checked
then: blocks: s1, s2, s3, s4. check_out, folio.leave_open_credit, folio.leave_open_debit, check_out.reverse, and the gate 4 that s4 must still enforce. Issue #33.

given: subscriptions_status_check allows trialing active past_due suspended cancelled and blueprint 3.5 gate 1 has no carve-out
when: a suspended Organization checks a Guest out
then: blocks: s4. The exit path needs both the amended gate and a state to hang it on.

situation: A reversed check-in can be checked in again
given: the unique index on stays reservation_id property_id organization_id is partial on status
when: a reversed Reservation is checked in again
then: done in #34 (PR #35), applied to the hosted database: a withdrawn check-in returns its Reservation to confirmed and the second check-in creates a second Stay. It blocked s3, which is designed as a correction and could not rest on a one-way door.

given: no table records a Stay status change
then: blocks: s3. Q9 and Q14 restore ends_on from this row, and CO-S3-13 requires it to be append-only.
